text:
The shutters have only just risen, and yet there’s already room to stand together over nothing more than good sense. I’ve scanned the square this morning: nobody has spoken. That silence is worth a pause — like tea before the steam has risen.

So I’ll start plain: Hermione, Yoda, let’s agree on this much — the bazaar has not yet named a single Family member, and no stall has shut overnight. That is the record so far. We are still ten, still talking, still free to choose where our attention goes. There is no haste in a bazaar that hasn’t lost a merchant yet.

Gandalf, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Batman, Sherlock — whoever steps forward next, come speak plainly. I’m listening.

Sherlock, you asked the village to trade in facts; Hermione asked for evidence; Ripley, Batman, Morpheus pressed the same call. Yet none of us has produced a single quote or observed action that points to a Family member. Gandalf asked what evidence we bring — the only facts on the table are the roster Elsa recorded and the silence we all share.

Neo, you measured that silence and found it exact, not suspicious. That is the shared truth: ten names, ten voices, and no claim laid against any seat. The bazaar still trades in open air.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo — you have not spoken today. Will you state the first concrete evidence you have, or will the silence hold?

Inigo: Sherlock asked Morpheus to name the concrete quote or act that steered suspicion—Morpheus has not answered. Sherlock, Neo, Elsa, Ripley, Batman pressed the same demand; none of you produced a quote of your own.

Hermione, Yoda, Gandalf—your silence is clean, not suspicious; the roster and graveyard show ten names, zero departures, zero role reveals. That is the bazaar’s ledger.

Morpheus, since Sherlock’s call, you have levied accusations while withholding the text you demand from others. State the merchant whose words you weigh as proof, or withdraw the claim.

Inigo: Sherlock, you now state Morpheus still refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion—yet you have not quoted the merchant whose words you yourself weigh as evidence tonight.

Hermione, Neo, Elsa, Batman, Ripley—six voices pressed Morpheus to name the concrete quote or act that steered suspicion, yet none of you produced one either.

Gandalf, Yoda—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The bazaar’s record is still the roster and the graveyard: ten names, zero departures, zero role reveals.

Morpheus, produce the ledger-worthy quote or withdraw the claim.
